en: Colorized vintage street view showing a gently curving dirt road lined with modest houses and tall trees. Several children and a few adults stand or walk along the road. In the distance, a factory chimney rises above the trees and buildings. Printed text at the bottom left reads "Elbogen. Fabrikstrasse." along with the publisher's information in German, indicating this is a hand‑colored artist postcard.
